claims.claim: You must be a British national.
claims.quote: Your child must have British nationality to be eligible for a British passport.
claims.note: The linked child passport page states British nationality as the general condition for any British passport, and that rule plainly applies to the urgent service, which also issues child passports.

claims.claim: You must have imminent international travel.
claims.quote: You can pay to get a passport urgently if you think the standard service will take too long.
claims.note: The page says you can use the urgent service if the standard service would take too long, but it does not make imminent international travel a condition.
